strings.Кратък тест за емоционално хранене — око: A short emotional eating test — about 3 minutes, no right or wrong answers. At the end you get a plan for the week: three concrete things and what to do when the urge is strong.
strings.Не всеки глад е глад. Разбери откъде идв: Not all hunger is hunger. Find out where the kind that isn't comes from — and what to do about it this very week.
strings.Отговорите стоят на устройството ти: Your answers stay on your device
strings.Когато импулсът е силен — първо пауза от: When the urge is strong — first a ten-minute pause.
No “do you have a problem” questions.
strings.Повечето са избор между неща, които са н: Most are choices between things that are normal for everyone, a few short scenes and four shapes.
strings.Без писане. Първото, което ти идва, е на: No typing. The first thing that comes to mind is the most accurate.
strings.Всеки вариант е нещо, което се случва на: Every option is something that happens to people.
strings.Накрая — план за седмицата: At the end — a plan for the week
strings.Три конкретни неща и какво да правиш, ко: Three concrete things and what to do when the urge is strong.
The result goes straight into your plan.
strings.Кога и защо храната поема чувствата при: When and why food takes over your feelings.
Three concrete things for this week.
strings.Хранителният план и асистентът го отчита: Your meal plan and the assistant take it into account — and it sounds closer to you.
strings.Отговорите стоят на устройството ти. За: Your answers stay on your device. For your personal text we send them to an AI model without your name.
strings.Без подготовка. Отговаряш, както ти дойд: No preparation. Answer however it comes.
strings.Не е медицинска диагноза. При хранително: Not a medical diagnosis. If you have an eating disorder, see a specialist.
The logic is ours. The results are yours.
strings.Хранителен план с точни грамажи, изчисле: A nutrition plan with exact portions, calculated for your body, health and goal, and recalculated every week.
Nutrition guidance, not a medical service. If you have a medical condition, consult your doctor.
